name: @bossnyumba/belief-engine
description: Epistemic belief store + convince-loop for the property operating system. Holds the brain's beliefs about tenant reliability, unit demand, and arrears risk, and revises a belief ONLY when corroborating evidence clears a 0.25 confidence-delta gate (0.05-0.25 queues for human review; below 0.05 is a no-op). Ships a DPO preference-learner, a LinUCB contextual bandit, Mem0 ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP fact semantics, and a nightly Pearson belief-vs-outcome correlation pass. Pure functions behind injected ports (belief store, web-search, outcome fetcher, audit sink, clock) — no direct DB/SDK/env. Default-OFF feature flag with a single wireBeliefEngine() composition export.
